lines.en: And your Pawnee High prom king and queen are...
-I broke the box, and I threw away all the votes,
and I voted for you 1,000 times.
You should get on up there, King Dwyer.
As your prom king, I am your ruler.
My first decree of power is to declare
that the prom queen shall be my wife, April Ludgate,
who is the best thing that's ever happened to me,
who came to prom, even though she hates it.
-This is your wife? How old are you?
I rigged an election and got kicked out of prom.
I can get on board with that.
